region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis patient screen program HCP1PL01: a pseudo-conversation that RETURNs TRANSID(EIBTRNID) with its WORKING-STORAGE COMM-AREA (no DFHCOMMAREA, so the COMMAREA is a layout_only record, #7434). The HCP1 transaction inquires through HCP1BI01 / HCIPDB01, HCPA adds through HCP1BA01 / HCAPDB01 / HCAPDB02. Every scenario starts with EIBCALEN 0, so the program SENDs the map and falls into RECEIVE MAP; the AID then selects the arm. Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. The chain has no DISPLAY, so sysout is compared (the default). The re-entry arm (EIBCALEN > 0, a COMMAREA the previous RETURN passed) is driven by commarea_hex scenarios: the program has no DFHCOMMAREA, so only EIBCALEN reads the bytes (#8121).

scenarios.name: inquire-patient
scenarios.why: HCP1 with patient 2: HCP1BI01 LINKs HCIPDB01, the fields are moved to the map and sent, then RETURN TRANSID HCP1

scenarios.name: inquire-unknown-patient
scenarios.why: patient 99 does not exist: HCIPDB01 SQLCODE +100, CA-RETURN-CODE > 0, NO-DATA sends the message

scenarios.name: add-patient
scenarios.why: HCPA with a user id: the postcode is upper-cased, HCP1BA01 inserts the PATIENT and USER rows, "New Patient Inserted"

scenarios.name: add-needs-userid
scenarios.why: HCPA with no user id: USERID-REQUIRED sends "User Id is Required"

scenarios.name: add-invalid-date-of-birth
scenarios.why: HCAPDB01 INSERT fails: HCP1BA01 returns non-zero, SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-ADD

scenarios.name: add-duplicate-username
scenarios.why: seed.sql holds a USER row named DUPUSER: HCAPDB02's INSERT is -803, the add fails and rolls back, NO-ADD

scenarios.name: other-transaction
scenarios.why: a transid that is neither HCP1 nor HCPA: no arm matches, the program takes the final RETURN

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF3: ENDIT sends "Transaction ended"

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF12: CANCELIT RETURNs TRANSID HCAZ IMMEDIATE

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID CLEAR: CLEARIT sends the map MAPONLY and RETURNs TRANSID(EIBTRNID)

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: no input: RECEIVE MAP raises MAPFAIL, HANDLE CONDITION sends ENDIT

scenarios.name: reentry-short-area
scenarios.why: re-entry with a one-byte area (the previous RETURN's COMMAREA): IF EIBCALEN > 0 GO TO A-GAIN (line 50), so the first-entry map send is skipped and the program goes to A-GAIN. The program has no DFHCOMMAREA, so only EIBCALEN reads the bytes (#8121)

scenarios.name: reentry-long-area
scenarios.why: re-entry with an eight-byte area (the previous RETURN's COMMAREA): IF EIBCALEN > 0 GO TO A-GAIN (line 50), so the first-entry map send is skipped and the program goes to A-GAIN. The program has no DFHCOMMAREA, so only EIBCALEN reads the bytes (#8121)
